turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Riya from SkillPath Academy. Is this Mr. Kapoor?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. I paid for my son's course two weeks ago and he still hasn't got the class link. This is ridiculous.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm really sorry about that. Let me check. Could you tell me the registered phone number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Same number you called. I've emailed twice, nobody replies. Worst service.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand you're frustrated. I can't see the payment on my screen, so I'm raising a ticket and asking my supervisor to call you within two hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Two hours, fine. But if it's not solved today I want a refund.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Noted. Ticket raised, my supervisor will call you today. Sorry again for the trouble.
